question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing striker, Dave is playing sweeper, Eve is playing center midfielder, Fred is playing goalkeeper, and Gertrude is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Fred and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Fred trade positions. Finally, Eve and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) right back
(C) striker
(D) sweeper
(E) center midfielder
(F) goalkeeper
(G) benchwarmer
solution:
Positions are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: left midfielder, right back, striker, sweeper, center midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer.
1. Dave–Fred: left midfielder, right back, striker, goalkeeper, center midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer.
2. Bob–Claire: left midfielder, striker, right back, goalkeeper, center midfielder, sweeper, benchwarmer.
3. Fred–Eve: left midfielder, striker, right back, goalkeeper, sweeper, center midfielder, benchwarmer.
4. Alice–Gertrude: benchwarmer, striker, right back, goalkeeper, sweeper, center midfielder, left midfielder.
5. Gertrude–Dave: benchwarmer, striker, right back, left midfielder, sweeper, center midfielder, goalkeeper.
6. Claire–Fred: benchwarmer, striker, center midfielder, left midfielder, sweeper, right back, goalkeeper.
7. Eve–Bob: benchwarmer, sweeper, center midfielder, left midfielder, striker, right back, goalkeeper.
Gertrude is playing goalkeeper, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
